title: Eleven Steps and One Door
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：courage　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 courage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my sister ① found the courage to knock on a door she had passed eleven times, and she said the finding was the whole of the afternoon. The ② courage, meaning the nerve and not the plan, lasted eleven steps and stayed that long; courage, she said, is the only thing in a corridor that is judged by how soon it is spent.

Every ③ courage in that family had the same stair, and the ④ courage at the end, meaning the one she kept for the letters and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever spoke of twice. Courage, my mother said, is nine parts spending and one part somebody willing to begin; my sister said the beginning is the part that fills eleven steps.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ courage was the whole of the toast, meaning the good wish and not the nerve. The ⑥ courage, meaning the good wish and not any of that, is the only thing in a toast that everybody raises and nobody defines; courage, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both a nerve and a good wish. She said the good wish is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ courage had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the stair. The ⑧ courage of the whole thing, my sister wrote in March, was one door and thirty years of beginning; courage, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to begin. He said the beginning was never mentioned.

The ⑨ courage I remember is the one at the end, which she found in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ courage, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being spent; every courage, she said, is a good wish that has agreed to look like a nerve. She said the good wish was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 勇气（指那股胆气本身，与那个计划相对）
C. 固定搭配：find the courage to do 鼓起勇气去做
D. n. 勇气（指那个家族里每一次）
E. n. 勇气（指末尾那一次）
F. n. 祝词；祝愿（旧义，祝酒时的 good courage）
G. n. 勇气（指信里提到的那一次）
H. n. 胆识；果敢（抽象总称）

items.q: found the courage to knock on a door she had passed eleven times
The courage, meaning the nerve and not the plan
courage was the whole of the toast

the courage had become a line in a letter

answers.why: find the courage to do 意为“鼓起勇气去做”，1961 年姐姐鼓起勇气敲响了一扇她路过十一次的门。
courage 意为“勇气”，指那股胆气本身而不是那个计划，它维持了十一步路。
courage 指那个家族里每一次勇气，每一次都在同一道楼梯上鼓起来。
courage 指末尾那一次（她留给写信的那一次），是唯一有人提起过两次的。
courage 为旧义，指祝酒时的祝愿，父亲说祝词就是那次祝酒的全部，指的是祝愿而不是那股胆气。
courage 为旧义用法，指祝酒辞里的祝愿而不是那股胆气，是祝酒里人人都举杯、却无人下定义的东西。
courage 意为“勇气”，指信里提到的那一次，到 1969 年这次勇气成了信里的一行。
courage 意为“胆识、果敢”，姐姐三月写道，整件事的果敢是一扇门三十年的开始。
courage 意为“勇气、胆量”，我记得的是末尾那一次，她 1975 年鼓起的，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
courage 为抽象总称，母亲说一股勇气是唯一会因为被用掉而变好的东西。
